cases.name: Elyse Marie Pahler
cases.narrative: They lured her to a eucalyptus grove on the Nipomo Mesa and strangled, stabbed and stomped her. Casey held her down while Delashmutt strangled her with his belt, and Fiorella stabbed her in the neck with a hunting knife. They took turns stabbing her while she lay on the ground praying and calling out for her mom. Then left her to bleed to death. After she died, the boys took turns raping her corpse.

cases.name: Cambria Grant
cases.about: She was a manager at the Cortina d’Arroyo Grande Senior Apartments.
